create_rotated_boxes: create a RotatedBoxes instance from a Nx5 tensor with x_center, y_center, width, height, angle
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise IoU between two RotatedBoxes lists of size N and M
clip_rotated_boxes: clip rotated boxes to image boundaries for near-horizontal boxes within angle threshold
scale_rotated_boxes: scale rotated boxes by horizontal and vertical factors with angle approximation
concatenate_rotated_boxes: concatenate a list of RotatedBoxes into a single RotatedBoxes using the cat class method
